title: As-Sami and Al-Basir: The Divine Names for Hearing and Seeing
excerpt: The pair stands together seven times. Six name God; the seventh gives the same two words to the human being as something made. One of the six opens a surah named after a woman who was heard.
seo_title: As-Sami and Al-Basir: The Hearing and Seeing Names
seo_description: As-Sami and Al-Basir stand together seven times in the Quran. Six name God, one names the human. Surah Al-Mujadila opens with a woman being heard.
